summary: Design measurable NRW contract scopes, KPIs, and payment rules. Explore the five-day course and strengthen your utility contract practice.
lede: Performance-based contracting for non-revenue water reduction links contractor payment to evidenced water-loss results. For utility contract managers, NRW specialists, procurement professionals and engineering leads, the course builds practical skills in setting IWA Water Balance baselines, selecting KPIs and data rules, and designing payment adjustments and evidence controls for measurable contracts.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who shape, procure, manage, or assess contracts tied to measurable water-loss outcomes. It is designed for utility roles that must connect NRW evidence with contractor scope, payment decisions, and service continuity.
modules: NRW KPI Design and Data Rules
prerequisites: Working knowledge of water utility operations, non-revenue water, procurement, or contract management is recommended. No programming is required. Exercises use contract scenarios and Excel-level calculations; advanced financial modelling and digital dashboard development are not implementation modules.
